name: printable-parts
description: Functional checks for 3D-printed parts, layered on text-to-cad (composed by name, never vendored): a prior-art search and a reference-model tier per device recorded before modeling, a measurable intent list per part checked on the exported mesh, a stale-file guard, cross-sections, a test-fit coupon, a print sheet, and a PreToolUse hook that gates mesh export and slicing. Start with the printable-parts skill.
